items.title: GOBOULT Debuts Tenet, Its First Designed-in-India TWS With 75-Hour Playtime
items.summary: GOBOULT has unveiled Tenet, the brand's first 100 percent designed-in-India true wireless earbuds, priced at Rs 1,299 with up to 75 hours of total playtime, 13mm drivers, quad-mic ENC and an ultra-low-latency gaming mode.

items.title: Noise Master Buds Open Pre-Booking Starts Ahead of India Launch
items.summary: Indian brand Noise has opened pre-bookings for its first open-ear clip-on earbuds, the Master Buds Open, tuned with Sound by Bose audio, a 10.8mm driver, 4-mic ENC and up to 28 hours of battery, launching October 23 at Rs 7,999.

items.title: CMF Clip Pro and Buds Neo Launch in Malaysia With Open-Ear and Budget ANC Options
items.summary: CMF has brought the Clip Pro open-ear clip-on earbuds (RM359, LDAC, 10.8mm drivers, 32.5h battery) and the Buds Neo in-ear ANC earbuds (RM129, 35dB ANC, 52h battery) to Malaysia, both on sale from October 19.

items.title: JLab JBuds Mini ANC Reaches Japan With Clip-On Case and Apple Find My
items.summary: JLab launched the JBuds Mini ANC in Japan on October 16 at 8,980 yen, packing active noise cancellation and a compact carabiner charging case that supports Apple Find My, with up to 7 hours of playback per charge.

items.title: UGREEN ClipBuds Pro 2 Open-Ear Clip Earbuds Go on Sale With LDAC
items.summary: UGREEN put the ClipBuds Pro 2 clip-on open-ear earbuds on sale October 1 at 99.99 dollars, featuring an 11mm titanium-composite driver, LDAC, Bluetooth 6.1, IP56 protection and a 46-hour total battery claim, with four mics plus bone-conduction voice pickup.

items.title: Galaxy Buds On vs Sony LinkBuds Clip: Samsung Plays Catch-Up in Clip-On Audio
items.summary: A head-to-head compares Samsung's new Galaxy Buds On clip-on earbuds with the Sony LinkBuds Clip, noting Samsung's stronger Galaxy-AI ecosystem features and slightly longer battery against Sony's broader iPhone and Android support and multipoint flexibility.

items.title: AirPods Pro 3 vs Sony WF-1000XM6: Which Earbuds to Buy in 2026
items.summary: A detailed comparison finds the AirPods Pro 3 the better pick for most iPhone users thanks to heart-rate tracking, Live Translation and Hearing Aid features, while the Sony WF-1000XM6 wins for Android owners and audiophiles with LDAC, a 10-band EQ and longer measured battery.

items.title: AirPods Keep TWS Crown as Global Earbud Shipments Fall for First Time Since 2023
items.summary: Omdia's Q2 2026 data shows global true wireless shipments slipped 0.7 percent year over year to 82.1 million units, the first annual decline since 2023, while Apple grew 1.2 percent to a 20.5 percent share led by AirPods 5.

items.title: Open-Ear Earbuds Boom While Traditional TWS Stalls
items.summary: Omdia data highlighted by eCoustics shows open wireless stereo shipments grew 12 percent to 11.1 million units in Q2 2026, with clip-on designs making up 61 percent of the category, as sub-50-dollar open-ear models surged 323 percent year over year.

items.title: The 7 Best Open-Ear Earbuds of 2026, Expert Tested
items.summary: Mashable tested open-ear earbuds from Shokz, Sony, Bose and others, naming the Shokz OpenDots One the best overall for workout use, with the Sony LinkBuds Clip as best newcomer and the Bose Ultra Open as best for comfort and sound.
